Fragments.Description: Straight run bitumen content by mass. Using ICE DB average aggregates. Cradle to mixed asphalt. Includes asphalt mixing energy (based upon MPA Sector Level HRA EPD, EPD HUB-1658, Aug 2024), transport of constituents by road to asphalt plant (assumed 250km for bitumen. 28.0 miles for aggregates [Ref: MPA Sustainable Development Report 2022]) and embodied carbon of ingredients. The transport of mixed asphalt to site is not included, e.g. cradle to mixed asphalt boundary. Density is for compacted asphalt. Embodied carbon of bitumen from EuroBitume Life Cycle Assessment 4.0 for bitumen, 2025.

Data.Name: Road surface, asphalt, 3% (bitumen) binder content (by mass)

Fragments.Description: Surface or binder course, at the stated average straight run bitumen content by mass. Cradle to constructed road surface. Using ICE DB average aggregates. Includes embodied carbon of ingredients. Also includes transport of mixed asphalt to site, distance 31 miles [Ref: Mineral Products Association, Sustainable Development Report 2022]. Density is for compacted asphalt. Includes road laying and compacting energy [Ref: TRL, report PRP575 (V4), Protocol for the calculation of whole life cycle greenhouse gas emissions generated by asphalt, M Wayman et al., 2014.]. Assumed 1% waste during road construction (assumption - specific data was not available). Embodied carbon of bitumen from EuroBitume, 2025.
